1 · Intro

When to use it.

Sometimes a non-exempt employee can't enter their own PTO. You can enter it for them on their time card using a pay code, such as vacation or sick.

Use this whenA non-exempt employee needs PTO entered and can't do it themselves.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in UKG. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Non-exempt PTO can be entered in 4-hour increments.
  • Open period: Save only. Do not submit.
  • PTO that came from an approved time off request may not be editable on the time card. Check with the manager before changing it.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Payroll & Timecards

Enter PTO for an employee

Use when: A non-exempt employee needs PTO entered and can't do it themselves. · System: UKG (Kronos)

  1. Sign in to UKG.
    • Bookmark the UKG link so you can get back quickly.
  2. Open the employee's time card.
  3. Add a row on the day of the absence.
  4. Choose the PTO type: click Browse and pick the pay code, such as vacation or sick.
  5. Enter the time.
  6. Scroll up and click Save.
  7. Exit and reopen the time card to confirm the entry saved.

Watch-outs

  • Non-exempt PTO can be entered in 4-hour increments.
  • Open period: Save only. Do not submit.
  • PTO that came from an approved time off request may not be editable on the time card. Check with the manager before changing it.
